reason: I forget my vitamins on the counter half the time, so a sachet that is already counted for tonight fits how I actually live. $24.99 for the first box is an easy impulse buy if a creator's video shows the problem.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put 8 forms in one capsule? I would not rebuy until I knew it does something for me.
would_change_my_mind: If the price was the full $29.99 with no launch discount, I would probably scroll past and not buy.
